local-llmup/0.6.1

Usage:
  $ local-llmup gui

Options:
  --port <port>     Port to bind on 127.0.0.1 (default: 4000) 
  --harness <name>  Start with this chat harness active 
  --no-open         Do not open the browser automatically (default: true)
  --json            Print the server URL as JSON instead of opening the browser 
  -h, --help        Display this message
